value.rationale: The union of the four singular cubic fibers of the canonical Hesse pencil has a natural connected generalized Jacobian. The complete integral Frobenius lattice is substantially stronger than the known 9 quadruple/12 node basket and rational cohomological eigenvalues: it identifies an anisotropic norm-one factor and 12 quadratic Weil restriction factors, and gives exact Picard point groups for all finite fields. The same geometry gives a nontrivial precise three-field ambient-plane-cover classification. This is a complete natural invariant for a motivated classical boundary, not a routine single-prime count.
